remarks: TURNKEY townhouse that feels like home in the heart of New Canaan with 3 full floors of fantastic versatile space. Purchased as a summer home, this easy floorpan flows nicely and includes chef's kitchen with breakfast area, open living/dining room, wet bar and wood burning fireplace. Study or bedroom on the main floor also includes fireplace and large windows. The second floor includes primary suite with newer all white bathroom and 2 large closets, and two more bedrooms, full bath and laundry area. The lower level has a bonus area of almost 1000 square feet of living space with high ceilings, full bath and fantastic wine cellar. So close to 17 acres of manicured nature trails in the Bristow Bird Sanctuary directly behind the home which leads to Mead Park and to the center of New Canaan shops, train, restaurants and schools. New Canaan living at its best!
